create_sim_agent: create a SimAgent instance from a URDF model file with specified actuation mode and pybullet client
actuate_sim_agent: actuate a SimAgent by passing a pose and velocity dictionary to apply PD or torque control
get_pose_from_sim_agent: get the current Pose of a SimAgent given a skeleton to extract joint transforms
set_pose_on_sim_agent: set the pose and optional velocity of a SimAgent using a motion Pose object
inverse_kinematics_sim_agent: run inverse kinematics on a SimAgent to move end effector joints to target positions
